# Package Registry Provider

Manages a self-hosted package registry: feeds and their upstream connectors, who may administer and publish, trusted OIDC issuers, replication peers, static tokens and quarantine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    registry = {
      source = "registry.local/sasokolov/registry"
    }
  }
}

# The endpoint and the credential come from the environment
# (REGISTRY_ENDPOINT, REGISTRY_TOKEN) so a token never has to be written into
# a .tf file. The identity must match one of the site's `admins` patterns.
provider "registry" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the registry, e.g. `https://registry.example.com`. Defaults to the `REGISTRY_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification. Development only.
- `timeout` (String) Per-request timeout, e.g. `30s`. Defaults to `30s`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) A registry token or OIDC id_token whose identity matches one of the site's `admins` patterns. Defaults to the `REGISTRY_TOKEN` environment variable, which is where it belongs: a credential in a `.tf` file is a credential in version control.
